full_prompt_en: A square presentation of a wide naturalistic oil painting shows riders and horse-drawn carriages passing through open countryside under a clouded sky. The selected painted scene is panoramic, with the horizon running low across rolling green fields and the gray-blue sky occupying the upper third. On the left, a white cottage with a red tiled roof and several brick chimneys sits behind a broad track. A line of mounted riders and a dark carriage approaches along that track, the horses alternating pale gray, chestnut, and deep brown. A small dog runs near the road edge in the left foreground. Across the center, grasses and low scrub separate the two tracks, opening a view toward distant trees and hills. On the right, another pair of riders and a pale horse draw toward the viewer along a narrower road, followed by a carriage and more distant figures. A second red-roofed cottage stands farther back among trees near the right edge. The unpaved roads curve gently and show pale dust, ruts, and patches of grass between hoof and wheel marks. Figures are small in the expansive landscape but remain distinct through careful hats, coats, harnesses, and horse silhouettes. Dark hedges and scrub frame the lower edge, while faint birds cross the sky above the central horizon. The paint blends broad atmospheric cloud passages with finer strokes in foliage, brick, and animal coats. Daylight filters through the clouds from above left, lighting white walls and pale horses while darkening the road edges and tree masses. The overall composition is leisurely and expansive, using two receding routes, clustered movement, and a broad tempered sky to give the rural scene depth and narrative energy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形排版中的宽幅自然主义油画描绘骑马人和马车在多云天空下穿过开阔乡野。选定的绘画本身呈全景，地平线低低横过起伏绿地，灰蓝色天空占上方三分之一。左侧，一座红瓦屋顶、带几根砖烟囱的白色农舍立在宽路后。一列骑马人和一辆深色马车沿路而来，马匹在浅灰、栗棕和深棕之间交替。前景左侧道路边，一只小狗奔跑。中央，草丛和低矮灌木把两条道路隔开，露出远处树木与山丘。右侧，另一组骑手和一匹浅色马沿更窄的路朝观者而来，身后跟着车和更远的人影。右缘附近，第二座红屋顶农舍坐在树木之间。未铺装的道路轻轻弯曲，可见浅色尘土、车辙以及蹄印和车轮痕间的草。人物在开阔风景里显得小，却凭仔细描出的帽子、外套、挽具和马匹剪影保持分明。深色树篱和灌丛框住下缘，细小鸟影穿过中央地平线上方的天空。颜料把宽阔大气的云层笔触与树叶、砖瓦和动物毛色中的细笔结合起来。日光从左上方透过云层，照亮白墙和浅色马匹，使道路两边与树群更暗。整体构图悠闲而宽广，以两条后退道路、成簇运动和宽阔温和的天空赋予乡村场景纵深与叙事活力。
style_prompt_en: The naturalistic oil painting combines panoramic spatial breadth with patiently observed small details. Muted sky blue, cloud cream, olive, ocher, russet, and deep brown are spread in broad horizontal bands, punctuated by compact moving accents. Light filters through cloud cover, picking out pale surfaces while darker foliage and lower margins hold the composition. Near textures such as rough ground and clustered leaves receive short distinct strokes; far fields and sky soften gradually into atmosphere. Two or more converging routes create depth and distribute focal activity across a wide frame rather than concentrating it in one spot. Edges are naturalistic but painterly, with brushed transitions in light and clearer silhouettes where value contrast is strongest. The overall effect is calm yet active, balancing expansive weather and land with finely scaled movement.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义油画把全景式空间宽度与耐心观察的小细节结合起来。暗天蓝、奶油色云、橄榄绿、赭黄、赤褐和深棕以宽阔水平色带铺开，紧凑的运动重音散布其间。光透过云层照亮浅色表面，较暗树叶和下方边缘则稳住构图。粗糙地面和成簇叶片等近处肌理由清楚短笔表现，远田和天空逐步柔化为空气层。两条或更多汇聚路线建立纵深，把焦点活动分散在宽幅中，而非集中一点。边缘自然主义却保留绘画感，受光处有笔触过渡，明暗对比最强的地方剪影更清楚。整体效果安静却有活动，在宽广天气与土地和细尺度运动之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Riders and horse-drawn carriages passing on two country roads
theme_zh: 骑马人和马车在两条乡间道路上交会
name: Heywood Hardy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
